messages:
marta: CI alert popped for the audit-event schema checker on master - the histogram diff failed :warning: https://ci.internal.redwood/18451/job/8723

deploy-bot: job 18451/8723 failed: audit-schema-checker (exit 1)

kevin: can you paste the failure snippet?

marta: here's the key part of the diff from the test run:
```
Expected histogram: {"event_type_counts":{"authz_grant":10,"key_access":5}}
Actual histogram:   {"event_type_counts":{"authz_grant":10,"key_access":4,"kms_rotate":1}}
AssertionError: histograms do not match (extra bucket: kms_rotate)
```
Looks like an extra event type showed up, tests consider that a hard mismatch.

samir: that would be from the KMS rotation telemetry I merged last night - we started emitting a 'kms_rotate' audit event when we rotate CMKs. I thought we were covered by the schema.

aj: hmm, adding new event types to audit schema is a product/security-visible change. Did we version the schema or add it as optional?

marta: the schema allowed arbitrary event_type strings but our golden fixtures are strict: the test compares exact histogram keys. So the new event type breaks the golden.

kevin: options:
- update golden fixtures to include kms_rotate counts
- change the test to ignore extra buckets for now (more tolerant)
- transform runtime test output to strip kms_* events until we do a formal schema bump
Which do we prefer?

samir: timeline: the KMS change is low-risk and customer-requested (auto-rotate), but we didn't coordinate the audit contract. I can hit a patch to make the test tolerant and also open a follow-up to add the event to golden fixtures with a note.

aj: prefer a conservative approach: make CI tolerant (so we don't block other merges) + a formal schema bump PR that documents the event type and intended semantics, with a customer-facing changelog and opt-in notes if needed. Also run the audit replay for impacted customers to ensure no downstream breakage.

marta: agreed. Concrete actions:
- @samir add a small CI transformer that filters out kms_rotate from histograms for now (so master green)
- @kevin add a unit test that asserts the schema permits unknown event types (schema contract) and add a note for maintainers
- create a schema-bump RFC and changelog entry before we ship the event permanently

kevin: quick transformer we can use in the test harness (jq):
```
cat hist.json | jq 'del(.event_type_counts.kms_rotate)'
```
Will drop the bucket before comparison. I'll add this to the test runner and add a short comment.

samir: I'll open a PR with the jq filter + integration test that simulates the rotation event. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/audit-tests/compare/patch-ckms

security-bot: Reminder: any change to customer-visible audit payloads needs compliance sign-off. Please attach the RFC to the compliance review queue and include a KMS access matrix showing which roles trigger kms_rotate.

marta: noted. @samir can you also run the replay against account:redwood-payments and account:enterprise-x (they requested full audit retention) and paste results here?

samir: will do. Running replay now, will post results to the PR.

deploy-bot: PR 18452 passed CI: audit-tests (patched harness)

marta: thanks everyone. Plan: short-term CI filter to un-block, add tests + schema RFC, compliance review, then update golden fixtures and remove the runtime filter. I'll file the follow-up tasks in the security board. :white_check_mark:

kevin: lgtm, will add maintainer note in the harness config.

marta: closing the thread, tracking in TICKET-SEC-241. :thumbsup:
